scope_note: Node/edge counts are runtime data-driven from Supabase tables mall_nodes/mall_edges. For Mall@Reds specifically the repo commits ZERO nodes/edges; any that exist live only in the unaudited Supabase project.

map_source.customer_map: Postgres node/edge graph (tables mall_nodes + mall_edges) rendered as a hand-authored 2.5D SVG in src/components/navigation/IndoorMapCanvas.tsx.
map_source.format: Pure inline SVG (viewport 360x172). No GeoJSON, no raster tiles, no map library, no real floor-plan geometry.
map_source.geometry_note: Node placement is synthetic: shops ordered by x_coordinate and dropped alternately above/below a hardcoded corridor line (CORRIDOR_Y=86). Real y_coordinate is ignored. Edge distances are estimates (ABS(dx)*5+30) generated in migration 005, not surveyed.
map_source.indoorMapModel_note: The route google-cloud-backend/src/routes/indoorMapModel.ts does NOT exist on this branch. Map backend is mapFactory.ts; routing backend is buildRoute.ts + routingService.ts.

map_file_format: SVG (schematic, generated in-component). Map Factory can also emit proprietary SVG floorplans (map_factory_generated_floorplans.svg_output, migration 019) but the customer map does NOT consume it.

floor_representation.model: mall_nodes.floor TEXT label per node (migration 005). No true 3D/z-axis.
floor_representation.inconsistency: Two floor-label conventions coexist (short codes G/B1/L1-L4 vs descriptive 'Ground Floor'/'Level 5'); routingService.formatFloorLabel exists to reconcile them.
floor_representation.frontend_floor_picker: Hardcoded fallback ['G','L1','L2','L3'] in NavigateScreen.tsx, otherwise derived from route steps.

counts.how_reds_nodes_would_arise: Migration 005 auto-generates one node per shops row + one 'Main Entrance' per mall, and edges to 3 nearest neighbours by x. Since Mall@Reds has ZERO committed shops, it has ZERO committed nodes/edges. Live-DB counts are unknown/unaudited.

store_node_links.mechanism: mall_nodes.linked_shop_id TEXT (migration 005:59). Not a mapping table.
store_node_links.resolution: Routing scans for linked_shop_id === shopId; if none, returns fallback:true.

special_node_types.note: Escalators/lifts/stairs/parking have NO dedicated glyph in IndoorMapCanvas — they exist in data but render nothing distinctive.

entrance_nodes: One synthetic 'Main Entrance' per mall on floor G (migration 005). Real entrance/parking-entrance survey data: none committed for Mall@Reds.
vertical_transition_nodes: Represented as edges with floor_change=true and node types lift/escalator/stairs. None committed for Mall@Reds.

route_algorithm.type: Dijkstra shortest path (real, textbook O(V^2)), weighted by edge distance_meters.
implementation_locations: (frontend has only a crude fallback estimator, NavigateScreen.tsx:19-29)
route_algorithm.divergence_risk: Edge function JSON.stringifies route_steps/destination_shop_ids into JSONB; backend service passes native arrays and comments that stringifying is wrong — the two paths persist the SAME columns in incompatible formats.

start_point_logic.effect: A fresh route almost always starts at the synthetic Main Entrance, regardless of where the shopper actually is.

route_preview_behavior: Static step list + a pulsing dot on the first not-yet-completed step. Completed vs remaining drawn as two polylines.

simulated_movement_behavior.advance_mechanism: Position advances ONLY when the user taps 'Done' (markStepDone). No setInterval/requestAnimationFrame/watchPosition. Only cosmetic CSS animate-ping pulse.

positioning_capabilities.gps_geolocation: PRESENT but coarse and outdoor-only — navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition used solely to pick the nearest mall (LocationContext.tsx). NEVER mapped to an indoor node.
positioning_capabilities.ui_misrepresentation: NavigateScreen.tsx:214-218 renders a hardcoded 'GPS' badge and a 'Prototype Tracking' label over the map with no positioning behind them — the most misleading UI element for an honest reality proof.

offline_capability.service_worker: public/sw.js registered in main.tsx — precaches app shell only (/, /index.html, /manifest.json).
offline_capability.reason: sw.js explicitly bypasses any supabase.co request, so mall_nodes/mall_edges/shopping_routes are never cached. Indoor map + routing do NOT work offline. SW purpose is PWA install + Web Push price alerts.

map_editor_admin_tooling.writes_to_live_graph: only on publish (mapFactoryRouteGraphBuilderService); protects human-curated nodes via source column (021).

mallreds_specifics.smoke_test_evidence: google-dev-agent/src/smokeTests.ts:526-535 has an explicit 'fallback mode' branch: 'Shop ID has no matching node in mall_nodes ... Route returned 0 steps' — i.e. routing for Mall@Reds is entirely contingent on live-DB mall_nodes.linked_shop_id being populated, which the repo cannot verify.

headline: Navigation is a real Dijkstra pathfinder over a synthetic, schematic node/edge graph with NO real indoor positioning of any kind (GPS is outdoor mall-selection only; the on-map 'GPS'/'Tracking' UI is decorative). For Mall@Reds the repository commits zero nodes, edges, and store-node links; whether any exist at all is a live-DB question this audit cannot answer.
